_mode: off = record nothing; audit = record only, PreToolUse never decides (stage D); enforce = PreToolUse applies the action of each category below (stage G).
_actions: block = deny, with the reason and the scope-request protocol; ask = Claude Code asks the user; warn = allow, with a reminder in the agent's context; audit = record only. Promote a category from warn to block once the metrics show it has no false positives (agent-workflow.md, section 13).
_docs_root: The docs area is per project: the "- docs root: <path>/" line of the root CLAUDE.md ## Workflow section (default docs/), read by the hook and by the project-docs skill. There is no docs key here.
